COST: 422

Notes on the plan:
- Shivapuri hospital is cut off: both of its roads are impassable, so car2 cannot move and is not used. All rescues therefore go to Galchhi shelter using car1 (4 seats).
- Driving total is 302 minutes across five trips (44 + 44 + 46 + 64 + 104). Deferral penalties total 120 (1 injured at Thakre care home, 80; 2 adults at Kalika farm, 40).
- Thakre care home can only be reached through Likhu care home, and its one injured person is deferred. Taking that person would require the longer Thakre route (+36 minutes), which costs more than the 80-minute penalty saved when the Likhu trip is filled with four people already.
- The Kalika adults are split: four are rescued on a dedicated 64-minute trip, and the remaining two are deferred because the Likhu trip is already full.
